what: Baseline snapshot timing is underspecified relative to multi-round revise
scenario_or_breakage: Plan says copy round-1 entry plan to plan-review-baseline.txt but _run_plan_review_round runs every round; a naive in-round cp on each call overwrites the baseline with post-revise plan.txt so later rounds compare against the wrong anchor and drift detection silently fails
suggested_fix: Capture baseline once before the first _run_plan_review_round (legacy and multi-round), guarded with [[ ! -f .../plan-review-baseline.txt ]], using the pre-revise PLAN_FILE for that session
